description:
modules/carecontract — GET /traeger/contracts (#4678, ADR 0153): the Träger binding of the Träger
transaction, the filtered list with version and party in one statement, the
count by status, then the tenant binding of each school whose contracts the
page shows, for its access log (ADR 0088 section 7). Flat in the number of
contracts; one statement more per school shown.
